hook_text: The pointer stops 2 marks past 300. Is that 302 grams, 320 or 340? Work out the marks.
clip_script: Tzaneen, a fruit and veg stall. 1 kilogram is 1 000 grams. Check the scale shows 0 first. Numbers every 100 g, 4 small marks between: 5 spaces, so each mark is 20 g. 2 marks past 300: 340 g of mango. Bathroom scale: 7 marks past 30, Rendani is 37 kg. A balance: 500 g plus 200 g levels the tomatoes, so they are 700 g. Potatoes 2 kg or tomatoes 750 g? 2 kg is 2 000 g, so potatoes win. Start at zero, read the marks, same unit to compare.
visual_style: A dial scale needle settling on a mark, then a balance tipping and levelling with mass pieces.
mood: Warm and lively, like a busy market morning.
pacing: The mark puzzle first, then the bathroom scale, the balance and the comparison.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and weigh three things in your kitchen.
